name: NOAA H13323: Cavern Point to Smugglers Cove

rights.attribution: NOAA Ship Fairweather; NOAA/NOS Pacific Hydrographic Branch; NOAA NCEI

spatial.note: Envelope includes extensive nodata. Native masks, not this envelope, determine qualified footprint. Compiler uses only 1–4 m native cells.

temporal.update_cadence: Historical survey; monthly source-catalog watch, hash-bound re-review if changed
temporal.source_time_basis: Survey dates retained in coverage_start/coverage_end; no timezone-qualified acquisition instant is asserted

evidence.supports: Official catalog identifies survey, variable-resolution BAG, explicit CC0 waiver, acquisition dates and MLLW/UTM11 reference.
Survey methods, coverage gaps, quality limits and horizontal/vertical control.
Downloaded and hash-pinned native elevation + product uncertainty. Embedded XML and 1/2/4 m native affine/arrays checked against GDAL supergrid reader.

limitations: Historical 2019 survey covering part of eastern Santa Cruz Island, not the entire island. Only native 1–4 m cells with finite product uncertainty qualify. Historical substrate interpretation remains uncertain; no individual boulder dimensions, current fish presence or catches are established.
Resolution is variable; grid size is not positional accuracy or a boulder dimension. Not a navigation product.

producer.name: NOAA/NOS Office of Coast Survey; NCEI archive

transformations: Native VR supergrid extraction; no low-resolution overview or interpolated ImageServer raster
Per-native-cell depth+product uncertainty+explicit 2 m planning allowance <=200 ft
4 m inward margin; historical mapped hard substrate; 75 m MPA/GEA geometry buffer
4 m display bins average actual native nodes; blanks stay blank; not used for depth qualification
